description: This file defines a migration class for version 4.6.0.1 of the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract migration class and implements methods for migrating up (though no changes are applied in this version) and retrieving the version number.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Migration class for version 4.6.0.1, responsible for database migration tasks specific to this version, extending the AbstractMigration base class.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Method intended to perform database schema changes for this migration version; currently, it performs no operations.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the migration version number as a string, '4.6.0.1'.
